Steam Networking support for Online Multiplayer

Dev note: Added Steam Networking support to Online Multiplayer. When a Steam user attempts to join an Online Multiplayer game hosted by another Steam user, Sunderfolk will attempt to use Steam's native networking service to connect.
For many users, this may improve connectivity and reduce latency. Online Multiplayer will still fallback to Dreamhaven's Cross-Platform networking services if a Steam connection is unavailable.
Fixed an issue where in some circumstances, the host may briefly see an error in the Lobby when hosting an Online Multiplayer session.
Fixed a bug where enemies were inadvertently receiving 'Cleanse' effect from fate card that targets heroes and allies.
Fixed a bug that can cause the EULA to not appear properly. This issue caused the controller app to appear 'stuck' since it was waiting for the user to accept an agreement they couldn't see.
Fixed broken 'YouTube' and 'Discord' links found in the main screen carousel.
We always encourage more feedback and suggestions for future updates! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server.
The Sunderfolk Team

March 23 Update: We are investigating some reports that Android users can get stuck on the startup loading screen after updating to 2.0.1 when using the Sunderfolk Controller App.

If you find that you are in this situation, please uninstall and reinstall the Android app and try again. This should correct the issue for you. We are continuing to investigate the root cause. Sorry for the trouble!
Please make sure you update your mobile Sunderfolk Controller app to successfully connect and continue playing Couch Co-op mode.
Fixed an issue where sometimes the "Skip Chat" button would not be visible while talking to NPCs in town.
Fixed an issue where certain poor network connections would cause an open online multiplayer lobby to unexpectedly close.
Fixed an issue that would cause players to become stuck on the startup loading screen.
Note: We are continuing to investigate instances of "Dreamhaven Online Service" errors inhibiting some users from playing Online Multiplayer and Couch Co-op modes. Single Player mode is unaffected.
We always encourage more feedback and suggestions for future updates! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server.
The Sunderfolk Team

Hey Guardians!
Patch 2.0 has arrived, with mouse & keyboard controls, PC Online Multiplayer, a new Hero, new missions, and bug fixes.
For details on each of the new additions, click HERE!
Please note: This update will also require you to update the Sunderfolk Controller App from your app store provider.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/3b2eabd3eb39c6a895a8425d89a58adca05d5fdb.png"]

notes.title: Now introducing Mouse & Keyboard Controls - A popular community request is now officially implemented.

items.text: Players can now play Sunderfolk directly on their computer using mouse and keyboard controls. No Sunderfolk Controller app required.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/473ec616bf4523e8687bef333dc3a150f749eb1f.png"]

notes.title: PC Online Multiplayer - A new way to play with friends and have more control over your main screen.

items.text: PC players can now play native online multiplayer games by hosting a lobby directly from the Sunderfolk menu.
Hosts can invite other PC players with an invite code after selecting “Online Multiplayer”.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/d44540420ca94b768189b33ea31aa8eeb351f49a.png"]

notes.title: New Hero: Vanguard - A new Hero has been added to the main roster.

items.text: The Vanguard joins the Guardians as a new Hero of Arden. This Hero focuses on retaliatory attacks and movement on the battlefield.
New mechanic: Knockback

Target character is Moved a number of hexes equal to the value stated on the Skill or Fate Card from the origin of their Knockback. Affected character Pushes or Swaps characters in their path, and may damage them.
For more details on the Vanguard, read HERE.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/eba53e91ab71e5960a46fce6e0f86d006dfa42a6.png"]

notes.title: New Missions: Arena Rumble & Sacred Sand - New Scenarios have been added to One Shot Mode.

items.text: Scenarios contain multiple missions that connect as a continuous experience.
To learn more about the new missions, read HERE.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/4c5518acafe581357bedf3e2922334853955c316.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/553c0cc4f21e4279dfbef8df246eb88d8237f574.jpg"]
Main menu update. Now includes options for Single Player, Online Multiplayer, and Couch Co-op Play Modes.
Couch Co-op Mode may be used for remote play using the Sunderfolk Controller app.
A new Tutorial was added during the third mission to explain the functionality of the WASD keys for any mouse & keyboard setups.
Fixed an issue where the Spell Card UI failed to be displayed on the Main Screen when quickly selecting a card after a Boss turn.
Invalid campaigns can no longer be selected in the Choose Campaign menu.
Fixed an issue where players were unable to upgrade certain Buildings if other upgrades were completed before the Workshop was ready to create the necessary Trinkets.
Removed an empty vignette that was displayed on the Main Screen at the end of the credits screen.
Fixed an issue where the “Town” menu was skipped when loading a save file left in Town after quitting the game.
Fixed an issue where a softlock would occur after opening the “Shared Settings” at the same time as a Weapon was being energized.
Wurmsbait will no longer perform a T-pose when being healed in the mission “Wurmsbait’s Mischief”. He’s since learned there are other ways of saying “Thank You”.
The Arcanist’s Book will now play an animation while attacking with an equipped weapon.
The ally Oozling is now immortal when playing in Brightstone difficulty.
Fixed an issue with the mission “The Prophet’s Notes” to no longer automatically end in a Withdraw if the main screen is disconnected from the network at any point during the mission.
Fixed an issue where the personal device for a player with multiple heroes in use would softlock when the “Exit to Hero Select” option is used during the level up screen.
Fixed an issue where the Arcanist’s “Bedazzle” could target and deal damage to other Heroes that lead to the game being softlocked.
Fixed an issue where the Arcanist’s Fate Card “Deal 1 additional damage for each Mana you have” subtracted damage when their mana was under 10.
Enemies will now be killed by the Fate Card “Execute target if they have less than 5 Health” while using the Bard’s “Join the Choir” Skill Card.
Fixed an issue where the Elite Ogre enemy would deal more damage than expected with the “Throw 2 a random adjacent character” ability.
Fixed an issue where the “Cursed Eye” Trinket dealt inconsistent damage to debuffed enemies.
GENERAL
Switch Character: TAB
Show Card Tooltips: F
Emote: T
Settings: ESC
Close UI: ESC
Open Menu: C
COMBAT
Inspect: Right Click
Ping: G or Middle Click
Confirm Action: SPACE
End Turn: SPACE
Clear Action: X
Undo Card Selection: X
Skip Action: V
Use Equipment: 1-6
CAMERA CONTROLS
Pan: WASD or Arrow Keys
Zoom: Mouse Scroll
We always encourage more feedback and suggestions for future updates! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server.
The Sunderfolk Team

Hey Guardians,
Sunderfolk Patch 2.0 arrives on March 10th! You can look forward to:
PC Mouse & Keyboard Support
PC Online Multiplayer
New Hero: The Vanguard
New Missions

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/3b2eabd3eb39c6a895a8425d89a58adca05d5fdb.png"]
But wait… there’s more! Behind the scenes, we’ve also been working on our next game, which we just announced today: Shadowstone.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/7a4fce8090791bcc7f1117faf80c3aa60c71260f.png"]

Shadowstone is a tactics roguelite game for 1-4 players that delves into the darker side of the world of Sunderfolk. Teams must master strategic positioning, tactical gameplay, and hero synergies to survive the horrors of the Sunderlands.
Read more about our latest project HERE and don’t forget to wishlist & follow.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/3b2eabd3eb39c6a895a8425d89a58adca05d5fdb.png"]
See you back in the Sunderlands on March 10th!
The Secret Door Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/8b9dfe8505edcd23658263ebdf48cb298a9bd342.png"]
Hey Guardians!
Thanks to your reports, we’ve found some bugs to squash in our latest update, and we’re excited to have a fix for them!
Fixed an issue that caused some campaigns to fail to load prior to downloading Patch 1.5 if a party was in the middle of the following missions:
Brightstone Cleanup
Lost in the Swamp
Wurmsbait’s Mischief
The Corrupted City
Please note, due to the nature of this fix, some campaigns that were in this state may resume in town instead of in the mission.
Fixed an issue that could cause One Shot Mode scores to reset upon exiting and relaunching Sunderfolk.
Added a fix provided by Unity to address a security issue.
Thank you for your diligent bug reports! We’ll see you in Arden.
The Sunderfolk Team

Nov. 25th Update: We announced our plans for Version 2.0, arriving in 2026!
Hey Guardians!
Our first new content patch is here! Read on to see what’s changing and being added to Sunderfolk.
Now introducing One Shot Mode - A new way to play your favorite Sunderfolk missions outside of the main campaign!
A full rundown can be found HERE!
Choose your difficulty mode and heroes before jumping in
Select any of the Sunderfolk missions from the campaign, including bosses.
4 new missions have been added exclusively to One Shot Mode.
Grading System: Increase your mission rank, up to the coveted S grade.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/3bf9bb6848b1e5a07412dd60e174db7cbe9ff344.png"]Perfect for game nights where you just want a bite, instead of a whole meal!
The New Missions - These are exclusive to One Shot mode and will test your acquired strategies to their limit.
Snack Run - Guide a Beetle to delicious treats. Hazards abound!
Slip & Slime - Slip and slide your way to survival.
Proving Grounds - Fight waves of enemies and emerge victorious.
You Asked For This - Developed with the Sunderfolk Discord community!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246535/4494a6b199c69d53565fc923a7c1707d6d7a6c1f.png"]It's finally here!!! Now who's getting the first S grade?
Game Start Revamp - Choose your preferred game mode: Campaign or One Shot Mode.
The first player to join becomes the designated party leader, and selects the party's game mode and campaign from their Controller app.
Players will no longer need to navigate menus using the main screen—Once the QR code is scanned, the Controller app can be used to control and navigate the main menu.
A new image carousel has been added to the Game Start flow.
Skip First 3 Tutorial Missions - Now you can jump straight into your next campaign. They will still be available in One Shot Mode.
New Targeting Colors - Customize your battle experience!
To change your targeting colors, navigate to Shared Settings -> Visuals -> Combat(Colors).
You can customize between Movement, Attacking, and Interaction text and visuals.
Updated the text in the Tavern and Tavern Upgrades UI to clarify the randomized meals players receive via the Meals System.

Removed UI “hover” behavior in Shared Settings to avoid accidental or unintended actions from players. Menu items in the left panel must now be clicked/selected instead of hovering over to change the contents in the right side.
Fixed a bug that could lead to a softlock when resuming the campaign after patching the game to the latest version.
Adjusted the Mission Summary text for the mission “The Fungal Vale” to help remove confusion about whether the side objective to save the Prophet and Sentinel was successful.
A Mushroom Ally NPC name has been localized for all non-English languages and will no longer show the developer name.
The Arcanist’s Passive ability information is now correctly displayed during the level-up screen.
Fixed an issue that did not recognize players having the required gold amounts for town upgrades if the gold was gained during the same town session.
Interacting with Tuya during her “Hide and Seek” conversation in town will now only cost 1 Conversation Point instead of 3.
The “Explode” action has been adjusted to accurately reflect the affected range, and doesn’t affect other characters or objects outside of the intended range.
Fixed an issue where the game could softlock after the Bard was knocked down after performing their Ultimate attack.
Trinkets are no longer consumed after being activated during the last attack action when the “Auto-end Turn” setting is enabled.
Fixed an issue where Fire created by the Pyromancer's skills did not appear on the map board over other ground objects.
Fixed an issue where the Button Mushroom ally did not teleport into a Mycelic Core hex during the “Lost in the Swamp" encounter. Silly little guy!

notes.title: The following two fixes contain major spoilers for the story of Sunderfolk.

items.text: Fixed an issue where the nameplate for the Lich would disappear when they were in the north section of the map.
Fixed a bug during the final mission “Sundered Shadows” that caused multiple Shadow Heroes to spawn in the final fight.
Berserker and Rogue passive icons have been added for a clearer visual for when their passive abilities are active.
Added patch notes and game Discord links to game start carousel.
We always encourage more feedback and suggestions for future updates! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server.
The Sunderfolk Team

Hey Guardians!
You’ve spoken, and we’ve heard! We’ve been collecting your feedback and seeing where Sunderfolk shines and where it needs polish.
This latest patch focuses on some popular community requests, as well as an expressive new feature.😁

notes.title: What’s New / Priority Fixes in Sunderfolk

items.text: Now introducing: Emotes
Players can now use Sunderfolk emotes with customizable text during combat and in-town.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeazcNiQ6OhmRBs7WFEmycE-Ud4Yeu99CGI-YgVNpgwAQR-Eh2rNnnkrISZ6D9HzdgdzPAP76nGdmNOY4QtBkTVDZ_H2L_hrwLfTqILBkFVmtbv6h-W0qSjM3wcApzrrERn_MvYbQ?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"] Just click the Smile icon and go nuts! This will appear in town and during missions!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf5GPiX2JiHenkpt6U3IyK0UkWriAPWcF37zRZUBds1OkoTuwR_rtLyJ0iDoGTqh7B4zEBNgaPbDY1bY_Rz_PukHxWWDZ0OPW2PRWIpyhN32R8C0NAzKm-O11AB-phW5uEzQm1s?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]
Renameable Player Prompts
Were you too much of a loremaster and now you have to show your campaign to your family? We’ve got your back! Players can now rename the in-game prompts through the Shared Settings menu.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvWy99FMDWhDXyxv61AUBHvdY0IArUgEhKDDO50qDovWchj98BWGW3SBj9wOPn5nxCFdDdUTM3NyuGH7fCW-jh4lYE_WAtg2qVvgMxQtvjL_462N-wuzkX4k3qLMRWZHqlxKA3eQ?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]
Name/Rename Your Campaign
Players will now be able to name their campaign party as part of the Hero Select process, which will be used as the Save File name.
Players may change their party name later via the Shared Settings menu.
For players already in existing campaigns, you can create a new name for your party through Settings -> Shared Settings -> Campaign Rename.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfAphr_7ylUNILu1MljdBu0m52RLmmk26Te_iRiPMc1uysEDrysUBpgf9qWjD-9wSFz3y0HwQbgntZ6O5FEBg4gRbnEuGpyWFxNhgvtqe1bad-OhcWRziyNiIfH3jbjKt9O0b17DA?key=dXOucwgLmqQ9mGthZxm1kLxP"]
Adjusted Boss Difficulty for Challenging/Shadowstone
Boss monsters now receive a +1 damage buff like other monsters, instead of the unique +2 damage buff previously used.
Nerfed the Salad
The Tangleroot Salad has been adjusted to prevent excessive creation of Vines.
The flavor text description for Tangleroot Salad has been updated.
Fixed an issue where the Ogre Queen would not take damage at the start of her turn if on a lava hex while Stunned.
Fixed an issue where Heroes will no longer gain an extra level when re-adding Heroes that had been previously dropped.
Adjusted the tooltip information for Berserker’s Rage ability to show the correct information.
Fixed an issue where players that joined mid-campaign did not gain the appropriate Fate Cards from the hero level-up rewards.
Fate Card Adjustment: Executes with enemies under 5 HP now work with area-of-effect and Ranged attacks.
Donated Trinkets will now prioritize being pulled from the player’s inventory before their equipment slots when donating at the Bug Pens.
Fixed an issue where if multiple players attempted to donate Trinkets at the Bug Pens at the same time, only one user would be able to donate Trinkets.
Adjusted several incorrect NPC conversations in town.
New players who join an ongoing campaign will no longer be able to speak with Evelyn indefinitely.
Town upgrades are now accurately displayed in the Bug Pens menu when multiple upgrades are made in a row.
Fixed an issue where a conversation with Tuya would not disappear from the Tavern location and can be seen multiple times, locking out further conversations with other NPCs.
(This section contains story spoilers! Read at your own risk) Fixed an issue where conversations with the Rabbits after the Sundership Down quest failed to appear after completing it.
Don’t worry, if you don’t see something you’d like, continue leaving feedback! The best places are on our socials and on our Discord server.
—The Sunderfolk Team
Hey Guardians!

We’re cooking up lots of stuff behind the scenes for Sunderfolk, and we’re so excited for this latest patch! We’re focusing on bug fixes, bringing some quality of life additions, and little doses of love!

Please note: The update will be released across all platforms simultaneously, but due to platform differences, you may see the update available for download at different times. Until both your Sunderfolk main game and Controller mobile app are updated, you will not be able to connect and play Sunderfolk. We expect the update to be available to all players (across all platforms) within 30 minutes of patch release time. All platforms will receive the update by 10AM PDT / 1PM EDT / 17:00 UTC.

notes.title: What’s New / Priority Fixes in Sunderfolk

items.text: Timestamps on Last Saved Campaign
The Campaign screen will now display the time when it was last auto-saved for the active campaign.
Main Screen Player Prompt
The main screen now shows whose personal screen needs to respond before it can proceed.
Auto-Save Notice
An Auto save notice will now appear on Game Start
New VFX

notes.title: New visual effects have been added for the following

items.text: Spider Webs
Redcap Spawners
Rubble
The Mimic Shrine
Minecart
The “Charge” ability
Mission Balance Change
(This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk) Adjusted the enemy spawns for 2-3 player games in the mission \Caravan Protectors, Dead of Night Pt. 1.\
Smithy Tier 4 Upgrade Fix
Fixed an issue where upgrading the Smithy to Tier 4 was not rewarding players with the additional Skill Card slot.
Device Disconnections
Reduced the frequency of disconnections under certain remote play situations.

Please note: While most players who experienced these problems should see less disconnections, we are still actively investigating further improvements related to connection reliability and for players unable to reconnect via QR code after being disconnected in a future patch.
The Sunderfolk Free Trial
Play the first 3 tutorial missions and one Act 1 mission during the trial.
Your trial save will continue if Sunderfolk is purchased.
Encounters
During the “War Council” encounter, Chirp will now successfully escape once they complete their mission objective.
The encounter "Shadow and Flame" now appears at the gates at the appropriate time during progression.
The Sentinel now correctly performs "Defy Defeat" when adjacent to a hero or allied actor, instead of repeatedly casting "Preserve" in the encounter "Sentinel's Pledge".
Revenants will now correctly drop "Revenant Shard" upon being defeated.
Characters
Inspired Heroes will no longer follow leaping spiders into pits.
A missing Zihao conversation is now available upon unlocking the Smithy for the first time.
Fixed an issue where the Arcanist was unable to use certain Skill Cards during the first round of an encounter after cancelling their choice.
Allies can now take damage from the Sentinel's "Sundering Blade" attack.
Ally Ooozlings may now swap with Heroes and Allies during their moves.
Equipment
The “Lit Oil Lamp” Trinket can now create fire on hexes occupied by gold coins.
Descriptions for trinket rewards are now accessible while on the victory screen.
Fixed an issue where the “Lucky Coin” Trinket incorrectly dealt damage twice to enemies surrounding the exploded gold pile.
Fixed an issue where the “Thread Dissolvent” Trinket could sometimes prevent mission objectives from progressing after using it to clear webs in the encounter “Smuggler’s Run”.
An issue preventing tooltips from appearing on certain weapons has been fixed.
General Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue preventing saves during the victory screen when an encounter was completed.
Mimic Shrines can now heal the Sentinel.
An issue relating to selecting donated items for building upgrades has been fixed.
Mid-encounter vignettes are now able to play when a personal device is still on a tutorial.
Player numbers on personal screens now match the main screen when reconnecting.
Custom weapon names now appear as intended during combat.
The Frenzy status icon now appears correctly in combat.
Stay tuned for June 17th when the Sunderfolk Free Trial arrives!
We’ll have more updates to share in the coming weeks, so please keep sharing your feedback in the Sunderfolk Discord. Thanks for playing, and we’ll see you in Arden!
The Sunderfolk Team
Hey Guardians!

Our first post-launch patch for Sunderfolk focuses on fixes for a few bugs and generally improves your Sunderfolk Controller experience! Thank you for your help in finding and squashing these bugs! (Don’t tell Esi)

notes.title: Stuck on “Press Any Key” Splash Screen

items.text: Made improvements to handling certain networking situations where some players may have been unable to continue past the "Press Any Button" startup splash screen.
While we've made improvements in our networking, there are more improvements / fixes coming in future patches we are actively working on. Specifically:
In some situations, players may see a blank QR code on the main menu screen for a period of time before it properly updates with a valid QR code.
Some Steam Deck players have also reported being unable to bypass the startup screens (logos / splash screen). We are actively investigating those reports and working on a fix.
Fixed an issue where players may have experienced a softlock after an Arcanist uses their “Stargate” ability on Wurmsbait [to teleport to the second island] during the mission “Wurmsbait’s Mischief”.
Adjusted text on one of the Bard’s Negative Fate Cards to correctly indicate its intended effect.
The original text “A random Hero or Ally in Range 3 of you Heals 3” has now been changed to “Choose a Target in Range 3 to Heal 3”
The Negative Fate Card “-2 Damage, Blind Each Monster in Range 2” now correctly inflicts Blind instead of Provoked.
The Berserker’s “Grisly Force” ability now ignores any active Shield buff on the Berserker to deal the intended damage when the “Deal” action occurs.
Fixed an issue where gold and loot did not always spawn on the map when a Rogue used their “Penny Pinch” Skill Card.
Fixed an issue where the Rogue’s applied Chroma color reverted to default when gaining Evasion.
The Ogre Queen no longer uses “Retaliation” when under the “Confused” debuff.
Enemies will now automatically lose the “Provoked” status at the end of their turn.
Fixed an issue where Bosses no longer clear the “Root” debuff automatically at the end of their turn.
Fixed an issue where enemies with Teleport and Leap abilities were gaining Haste buffs with the “Frenzy” passive.
Fixed an issue where Guard Bug Allies summoned from Trinkets no longer skip their remaining actions when swapping with a Hero.
Ally attacks will no longer trigger enemies’ Frenzy passive in Challenging or Shadowstone difficulty.
Chirp is now able to use their Move action after activating her “Bulldoze” ability and dealing damage to enemies.
[This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] Fixed an issue where a Round Timer is missing in (“All That Glitters”), causing the missions to be blocked from progressing.
[This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] Fixed an issue where Heroes would lose more than the intended one Skill Card when deselecting a Skill Card while under the effects of “Fear”.
Fixed an issue where players may experience a main screen freeze after changing settings during missions.
Fixed an issue where spamming the “+” add button on Character Select causes a softlock for players.
Fixed an issue that was causing looping conversations.
Fixed missing and broken audio events in-game.
Adjusted the description for the “Black Inkwell” trinket to match its functionality.
[This is a story-spoiler: Read at your own risk] The mission (“Sundered Shadows”) will be reset to start from the beginning if it was saved and players quit in-progress.*

*Developer Note: Some patches for Sunderfolk may reset the specific mission you are on at the time of the update, if we’ve made changes to how that specific mission works. This will send you back to town, but it will improve your overall experience with the mission. We’ll aim to give more advanced notice if these resets are coming in future patches. Thanks for rolling with it! 🎲
Don’t see an issue you reported? Don’t worry, this is just the beginning of our upcoming patches, so stay tuned!
The Sunderfolk Team
